title: I can't sign in
summary: Your password isn't accepted, or signing in gets stuck.

steps.title: Is your account safe?
instructions: Think about whether anyone else might know your password.
Think about whether you've seen messages about sign-ins or changes you didn't make.
steps.warning: Never share your password with anyone, including friends. This tool will never ask for it.
steps.question: Do you think someone else knows your password or has used your account?

steps.title: Check for special screens
instructions: Look at your screen for any of these messages: "OS verification is off", "ChromeOS is missing or damaged", or a message that the device is disabled.
If you see one, do NOT press any keys.
steps.question: Do you see one of these messages?

steps.title: Forgot your password?
instructions: Only your school can reset a password or unlock an account.
steps.question: Did you forget your password, or does the screen say your account is locked?

steps.title: Check Caps Lock
instructions: Look for an up-arrow icon near the password box or at the bottom of the screen. It means Caps Lock is on.
If it is on, press Alt + Search to turn it off.
steps.question: Did you sign in?

steps.title: Use your full school email
instructions: Make sure you typed your full school email address, including everything after the @ sign.
steps.question: Did you sign in?

steps.title: Check the internet connection
instructions: Look at the Wi-Fi icon in the bottom-right corner of the sign-in screen.
Signing in usually needs an internet connection.
steps.question: Does the Wi-Fi icon show you are connected?

steps.title: Turn it off and on again
instructions: Press and hold the power button until the screen goes dark.
Wait 10 seconds, then press the power button once to turn it back on.
steps.question: Did you sign in?
